$comment: Synthetic AC-21..AC-30 scenario records with known-good controls, seeded faults and adversarial controls, plus a per-cell four-stack handoff. No consumer app, driver or device exists in this worktree, so every automated command is an ILLUSTRATIVE_NON_EXECUTABLE template and every cell is BLOCKED/NOT_RUN. Nothing here asserts device execution.

AC-29.name: Secure storage, logout and log hygiene

ios.reason: No build; synthetic session token required
prerequisites: synthetic account token issued by the fixture
ios.automatedCommand: timeout 60 xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --level debug --predicate 'process == "CheckoutApp"' > "$LOG_CAPTURE" & xcodebuild test -project "$IOS_PROJECT" -scheme "$IOS_UI_SCHEME" -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16 Pro,OS=18.0' -only-testing:CheckoutAppUITests/SessionTests; grep -c "$SYNTHETIC_TOKEN" "$LOG_CAPTURE"
ios.expectedOutcome: Zero token matches in the bounded, redacted log capture; logout invalidates the stored session
ios.cleanup: Delete "$LOG_CAPTURE" and stop the log stream (timeout bounds it)
ios.manualLane: Inspect Console logs and Keychain contents after a synthetic login/logout

android.reason: No APK; logcat session inspection needs a device
android.expectedOutcome: Zero token matches in the bounded, redacted capture; logout clears the session
android.manualLane: Manual logcat and EncryptedSharedPreferences inspection after logout

flutter.reason: No Flutter build for secure storage checks
prerequisites: flutter_secure_storage as the app uses it
flutter.automatedCommand: adb logcat -c && patrol test -t integration_test/session_test.dart --dart-define=ENV=synthetic && adb logcat -d -t 500 > "$LOGCAT_CAPTURE"; grep -c "$SYNTHETIC_TOKEN" "$LOGCAT_CAPTURE"
flutter.expectedOutcome: No token material in the bounded capture; logout clears secure storage
flutter.manualLane: Manual logcat and secure-storage inspection on a physical device

react-native.reason: No RN build for keychain/log checks
react-native.automatedCommand: timeout 60 xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --level debug --predicate 'process == "CheckoutApp"' > "$LOG_CAPTURE" & npx detox test -c ios.sim.debug e2e/session.e2e.js --grep "logout invalidates"; grep -c "$SYNTHETIC_TOKEN" "$LOG_CAPTURE"
react-native.expectedOutcome: No token material in the bounded capture; logout invalidates the stored session
react-native.cleanup: Delete "$LOG_CAPTURE" and stop the log stream (timeout bounds it)
react-native.manualLane: Manual Console log and Keychain inspection on a physical iPhone
